courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的鐵道與交通設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring railway and transport systems through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 鐵路連續焊軌應變監測
related.titleEn: Strain monitoring of continuously welded rail
related.transfer: 可遷移「輪緣槽幾何誤差預算」與「路面混行的停止距離」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；鐵路連續焊軌應變監測的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Flangeway geometry uncertainty budget" and "Stopping distance in shared streets" transfer, while operating boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Strain monitoring of continuously welded rail must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦槽型鋼軌輪緣界面排水與街道交通協調；鐵路連續焊軌應變監測則以以溫度補償和獨立基準追蹤連續焊軌應變為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on grooved-rail flange interfaces, drainage and street-traffic coordination; Strain monitoring of continuously welded rail centres on temperature compensation and independent references for continuous-welded-rail strain, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「輪緣槽幾何誤差預算」與「完全拘束的熱應力量級」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到鐵路連續焊軌應變監測，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「溫度與應變時間對齊」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Flangeway geometry uncertainty budget” and “Thermal stress under full restraint”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Strain monitoring of continuously welded rail, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Aligning temperature and strain records", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 無架空線輕軌供電

related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Flangeway geometry uncertainty budget" and "Stopping distance in shared streets" transfer, while operating boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Catenary-free light-rail power systems must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦槽型鋼軌輪緣界面排水與街道交通協調；無架空線輕軌供電則以區分分段地面供電與車載儲能的無架空線系統為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on grooved-rail flange interfaces, drainage and street-traffic coordination; Catenary-free light-rail power systems centres on distinguishing segmented ground supply from onboard energy storage, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「輪緣槽幾何誤差預算」與「輪周功率與電源需求」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到無架空線輕軌供電，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「電源模式交接時序」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Flangeway geometry uncertainty budget” and “Wheel power and supply demand”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Catenary-free light-rail power systems, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Power-mode handoff timing", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 輕軌槽型鋼軌街道整合
history.titleEn: Street integration of grooved-rail light rail
history.text: 本課以可查核的工程與方法出版歷程建立背景：2006 年公路鐵路交會處的人因指引報告出版。；2019 年公路鐵路平交道手冊第三版出版。；2025 年鐵路可靠度與安全方法第一分冊發布。這些日期分別是工程事件、指南重印或標準研究出版，並非宣稱本課系統在該年問世。對槽型鋼軌輪緣界面排水與街道交通協調而言，歷史脈絡的價值是理解需求如何從單一設備擴展到跨介面證據。本課再用街道集水與排水需求及混行路口車尾清空連結這些方法；代表工程僅提供觀察方向，假想參數不冒充現場資料，歷史版規範也不自動等於當地現行要求。
history.textEn: The background uses checkable project events and methodological publication history. 2006: Human-factors guidance for highway–rail intersections was published. 2019: The third highway–rail crossing handbook edition was published. 2025: A new first part of railway RAMS was published. These dates identify project events, guide reprints, or standards and research publications, rather than claiming that the lesson system first appeared then. For grooved-rail flange interfaces, drainage and street-traffic coordination, the useful historical perspective is the expansion from individual equipment to evidence across interfaces. The course connects that perspective through street runoff and drainage demand and rear clearance at shared intersections. Reference projects guide observation only: hypothetical parameters are not field data, and historical editions do not automatically establish current local requirements.
